findings.claim: FY2023-2025 無任何客戶占淨營收超過10%；2025年底一個客戶與一個夥伴機構分別占應收帳款淨額12%與23%；兩家支付處理商占交易費用56%（2024年48%）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 財報附註
findings.excerpt: During the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, no customer accounted for more than 10% of net revenues. During the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, two payment processors accounted for 56% and 48% of transaction expense, respectively.

findings.claim: 截至2026-06-30，PayPal仍獲S&P、Fitch、Moody's投資等級評等（搜尋未見2026年信評調降）。
findings.excerpt: As of June 30, 2026, we continue to be rated investment grade by Standard and Poor's Financial Services, LLC, Fitch Ratings, Inc., and Moody's Investors Services, Inc.

note: 僅搜尋1次；客戶自身信用惡化無證據；分析師降評與指引下修屬另軸。
